metadata.title: Mixed configuration spaces, fixed points and Loop braid groups
metadata.abstract: We introduce the notion of mixed configuration spaces of the $3$-ball. That is, we consider both distinct circles and distinct points in the interior of the $3$-ball and we prove that the projection onto the configuration space of circles of the $3$-ball is a locally trivial fibration. The key idea for defining the mixed configuration spaces is to study fixed points of orientation-preserving homeomorphism of the $3$-ball that leave invariant a trivial link of $n$ components in the interior of the $3$-ball. In particular, we prove that two fixed points are Nielsen equivalent if and only if the associated loop braids are conjugate by an element of a distinguished free subgroup of rank $n$. This result stands as a $3$-dimensional counterpart of the $2$-dimensional result where fixed points of homeomorphisms of the punctured disc are characterized in terms of braid elements of the classical Artin braid group.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 混合构形空间与 loop braid
analysis.workSummary: 定义三球内圆与点的混合构形空间，证明到圆构形空间的局部平凡纤维化；固定点 Nielsen 等价对应 loop braid 在指定秩 n 自由子群中的共轭。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立二维 punctured-disc 固定点 braid 理论的三维对应。
analysis.limitations: 空间内的圆组成 trivial link，且自同胚保向并保持该 link。
